description: Provides translation and number formatting functions for the current locale, along with the RTL state.

exposed.decimalSeparator: The decimal separator character for the current locale (e.g. `.` for en, `,` for de).
exposed.isRtl: Indicates if RTL is currently active or not.
exposed.name: Name of the locale adapter used.
exposed.numericGroupSeparator: The digit grouping separator for the current locale (e.g. `,` for en, `.` for de).
